home.name: Benjamin Balayre
home.role: Strategy & Transformation Consultant | Data, Business Intelligence & AI | Freelance Web Developer
home.welcome: Welcome to my website, a space dedicated to discovering my background and passions. You will find information about my professional, personal and associative projects.
home.education_desc: Always passionate about innovation and new technologies, I chose to pursue a degree in digital engineering at ISEP.
home.experience_desc: My goal: to consolidate my expertise in the digital field while understanding its challenges to actively contribute to tomorrow's innovations.
home.associative_preview_desc: My student years were deeply shaped by student associations: the student union, the school media association I ended up chairing, and an FPV drone club I helped found.
home.projects_title: What I build on the side
home.projects_lead: My engineering path has a counterpart: a freelance business I have run since 2024. I design websites and web products, and I turn the results into a limited edition print shop. Photo and video have a page of their own.

associative.title: Associative Experience
associative.hero_desc: Associative engagement has been a cornerstone of my education. Find details of my involvements and the projects I led during my studies.

iseplive.title: ISEP Live
iseplive.presentation_desc: ISEP Live is the school's media association. Our 25-member team covers all of student life and major events (Integration Weekend, Ski Week, etc.) through photography and video.
iseplive.iseplife_desc: The association internally develops and maintains the ISEP Life mobile app, a true hub for campus life: agendas, student directories, association news, and media galleries.
iseplive.path_desc:
I joined ISEP Live in September 2022 to improve my photography and audiovisual skills alongside other enthusiasts.

I became Vice-President the following year, coordinating creation departments and significantly strengthening my project management and teamwork skills.

Continuing this commitment, I took on the presidency in 2024. This foundational experience taught me to lead a 25-person team, oversee the art direction of our productions, and structure our overall development.
iseplive.lead: The school’s media association: twenty-five people covering campus life in photo and video.
iseplive.description: The media association of ISEP. Member in 2022, vice-president in 2023 then president in 2024, leading a team of twenty-five people covering campus life in photo and video.

vizion.title: Student Council: Vizion
vizion.presentation_desc:
The Student Council (BDE) is the central body of associative life. The Vizion team, with its 40 members, set the pace for the student year with its events and projects.

I mainly worked within the Creation department, ensuring the visual identity of our term (logos, social media communication, apparel).
vizion.path_desc:
Being part of a Student Council is a tremendous experience in high-pressure teamwork. In the Creation department, I expressed my creativity while meeting strict deadlines and concrete communication needs.

This human adventure gave me a real vision of event management, but more importantly, it built invaluable adaptability and collaboration skills.
vizion.lead: The ISEP student union: forty people setting the rhythm of the student year, including a creative team that signed the visual identity of the term.
vizion.description: The ISEP student union, forty people, for the 2023 term. Member of the creative team, responsible for its visual identity: logos, social media, merchandise.

isepdrone.title: ISEP Drone
isepdrone.presentation_desc:
First Person View (FPV) flying allows the pilot to steer a drone by seeing exactly what the onboard camera films through a video headset.

I helped found the ISEP Drone club in 2021 with a group of enthusiasts. Our mission: to democratize this technical discipline through assembly workshops, simulator coaching, and outdoor flight sessions.
isepdrone.path_desc:
As a founding member, I first ran the creative and communication team: I shaped the visual identity of our new structure and managed digital communication to attract new members.

This dynamic naturally led me to the club presidency in 2022. This exciting term allowed me to organize internal competitions and run our weekly sessions, granting me solid experience in leading small teams and technical teaching.

I then supported the next generation as Vice-President, in 2023 and again in 2024.
isepdrone.lead: A club founded in 2021 to open first-person-view flying to students: build workshops, simulator sessions and flight outings.
isepdrone.description: An FPV flying club founded in 2021. Creative and communication lead in the first year, president in 2022, then vice-president in 2023 and 2024: build workshops, simulator sessions and flight outings.

associative.summary_desc: A student media association, a student union and a drone club: three organisations I helped run during my studies at ISEP.

capgemini_cdi.title: Strategy & Transformation Consultant, Capgemini Invent
capgemini_cdi.description: Full-time position within frog, the design and innovation arm of Capgemini Invent, following on from my internship. Supporting large accounts through their data and AI transformations: scoping needs, designing use cases, and deploying solutions at scale.

capgemini.title: Intern Consultant, Capgemini Invent (frog)
capgemini.description: Internship within the Frog Customer Data & Tech service. Design of innovative strategies and support for large-scale digital transformations. Consulting missions for general management on strategy, organization, and operational efficiency.

sidetrade.title: Intern Data Analyst, Sidetrade
sidetrade.description: Internship in the Datalake Ingest team. Analysis of datalake data, creation of strategic dashboards (Power BI), and collaboration with R&D and Product teams in an English-speaking environment.

freelance_dev.title: Freelancer, web & application developer
freelance_dev.description: Design and development of websites and online applications for independent professionals and small organisations. End-to-end ownership of each project: scoping, mockups, development, deployment, and maintenance.

freelance.title: Freelancer, photographer & videographer
freelance.description: Production of photo and video content for events and professional projects. Complete management of customer relations, shooting, editing, and artistic direction.
freelance.card: Photo and video work for events and professional projects: aftermovies, brand films, reportage. I take projects end to end, from scoping the brief to the final cut.

microsoft.title: Observation internship at Microsoft
microsoft.description: Observation internship within Microsoft, allowing discovery of software engineering professions, exploration of the digital world, and confirmation of orientation towards technologies and innovation.

relive.title: ReLive, selfie search for photo galleries
relive.card: A wedding guest enters the gallery code, takes a selfie, and gets every photo they appear in within seconds. Face recognition, vector index, photographer dashboard: designed and built end to end.
relive.description: A web product born from a simple observation: after a wedding, nobody scrolls through two thousand gallery photos to find their own. ReLive solves it with face recognition. The photographer uploads the gallery, each guest identifies themselves with a selfie and retrieves their photos. Product design, Python API, face recognition model, vector index, web interface and hosting: the whole project is built solo.

benevolence.title: Benevolence, fine art print shop
benevolence.card: My fine art print shop: images brought back from my travels, released in limited editions on canvas, aluminium, acrylic or paper. From selecting the images to running the shop, everything is done in-house.
benevolence.description: An online shop for fine art prints from my travels, in limited editions on canvas, aluminium, acrylic or paper. Image selection and preparation, brand identity, shop setup and order fulfilment.

seed4soft.title: Seed4Soft, website rebuild for a business angel collective
seed4soft.card: A full rebuild of the Seed4Soft website, a business angel collective: scoping, design system, development and release. Next.js, Tailwind CSS, bilingual content.
seed4soft.description: A full rebuild of the website of Seed4Soft, a business angel collective. Scoping with the team, design system, development in Next.js and Tailwind CSS, bilingual editorial content, then release to production. The site is live and I keep improving it.

oslomet.title: OsloMet, Oslo (Norway)
oslomet.summary: Third year of the ISEP engineering cycle · Data Science & Artificial Intelligence
oslomet.description: Exchange semester completed as part of my engineering cycle at ISEP, focused on Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. An academic immersion that let me study business intelligence systems with an international approach, in English and within multicultural teams.

isep_ing.title: ISEP, engineering cycle (Paris)
isep_ing.description: Digital engineering curriculum with a specialization in Business Intelligence (BI) and data architecture. Comprehensive training in IT professions, from software design to IS management, including an exchange semester at OsloMet (Norway).

inha.title: Inha University, Incheon (South Korea)
inha.summary: Second year of the ISEP integrated international cycle · System programming & leadership
inha.description: Exchange semester completed as part of my integrated international cycle at ISEP, featuring courses in system programming, leadership, electronics and Korean language. My first time living abroad, and culturally one of my most impactful experiences.

isep_cii.title: ISEP, international integrated preparatory programme
isep_cii.description: Integrated preparatory programme of ISEP's international track, leading straight into the engineering cycle. Intensive training in mathematics, digital sciences and electronics, in an international environment including an exchange semester at Inha University (South Korea).
